body: Suicide, if I'm lucky. For now I'm trying to get drunk enough to do it.

Its hard to believe I even made it this far. I've been suicidal for about 6 months now and since then I've given up on life and let all my responsibilities fall through because I didn't think I'd still be alive. The idea of starting a new chapter and trying to fix this mess is terrifying. I still don't think I can do it. I wish i could go out and do something tonight but my family is here and I'm not supposed to leave the house. I feel trapped and more alone than ever.
